title: Frontend entry scenario slow list render
topic: Frontend entry scenario slow list render
question: The page feels noticeably janky when this list updates. What would you investigate, and what would you try first?
idealAnswer:
Open the browser's performance profiler to confirm where time is actually being spent, rather than guessing, it might be layout/paint, JS execution, or something else entirely

Check whether every keystroke triggers a full re-render of all 2,000 items rather than only re-rendering what changed, and whether list items are missing stable keys, causing unnecessary re-creation

Consider debouncing or throttling the filter input so filtering logic runs after typing pauses, rather than on every single keystroke

Consider list virtualization (rendering only the rows currently visible in the viewport) since rendering thousands of DOM nodes at once is expensive regardless of framework

Check if expensive work (like the filter/search logic itself) is being recomputed from scratch each render instead of memoized, and whether it could run in smaller chunks or off the main thread
